nodes.Name: Handler
nodes.DocComment:
A Handler handles log records produced by a Logger.

A typical handler may print log records to standard error,
or write them to a file or database, or perhaps augment them
with additional attributes and pass them on to another handler.

Any of the Handler's methods may be called concurrently with itself
or with other methods. It is the responsibility of the Handler to
manage this concurrency.

Users of the slog package should not invoke Handler methods directly.
They should use the methods of [Logger] instead.

Before implementing your own handler, consult https://go.dev/s/slog-handler-guide.

nodes.Name: Handle
nodes.DocComment:
Collect the level, attributes and message in a string and
write it with the default log.Logger.
Let the log.Logger handle time and file/line.

nodes.Name: HandlerOptions
nodes.DocComment:
HandlerOptions are options for a [TextHandler] or [JSONHandler].
A zero HandlerOptions consists entirely of default values.

Fields.Name: json
Fields.DocComment: true => output JSON; false => output text

Fields.Name: nOpenGroups
Fields.DocComment: the number of groups opened in preformattedAttrs

nodes.Name: enabled
nodes.DocComment:
enabled reports whether l is greater than or equal to the
minimum level.

nodes.Name: handle
nodes.DocComment:
handle is the internal implementation of Handler.Handle
used by TextHandler and JSONHandler.

nodes.Name: attrSep
nodes.DocComment: attrSep returns the separator between attributes.

nodes.Name: handleState
nodes.DocComment:
handleState holds state for a single call to commonHandler.handle.
The initial value of sep determines whether to emit a separator
before the next key, after which it stays true.

Fields.Name: sep
Fields.DocComment: separator to write before next key

Fields.Name: groups
Fields.DocComment: pool-allocated slice of active groups, for ReplaceAttr

nodes.Name: groupPool
keyComponentSep
nodes.DocComment: Separator for group names and keys.

nodes.Name: openGroup
nodes.DocComment:
openGroup starts a new group of attributes
with the given name.

nodes.Name: closeGroup
nodes.DocComment: closeGroup ends the group with the given name.

nodes.Name: appendAttrs
nodes.DocComment:
appendAttrs appends the slice of Attrs.
It reports whether something was appended.

nodes.Name: appendAttr
nodes.DocComment:
appendAttr appends the Attr's key and value.
It handles replacement and checking for an empty key.
It reports whether something was appended.

nodes.Name: appendTwoStrings
nodes.DocComment: appendTwoStrings implements appendString(prefix + key), but faster.

nodes.Name: DiscardHandler
nodes.DocComment:
DiscardHandler discards all log output.
DiscardHandler.Enabled returns false for all Levels.
